custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'waxy' appearance of the food items. In AI images, baked goods often lose their porous texture and look like plastic or clay. Check if the expert classifiers identify these as actual food items or just 'brown objects'. Also, scrutinize the straight lines of the metal/glass shelves for any bending or melting, which is a common failure mode in rigid object generation.
